title: Multi-Sensitive Distributional Fairness: Joint Wasserstein Audits and Shapley Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fairness audits with several sensitive attributes are often performed one coordinate at a time. This can miss purely intersectional disparities: a score may be independent of each sensitive coordinate while depending on their joint profile. We study distributional demographic parity for a real-valued score using one-dimensional Wasserstein geometry. We distinguish two complementary constructions. Conditional and sequential audits characterize joint parity through their zero sets, but their positive values do not generally decompose a fixed joint Wasserstein disparity. By contrast, full-cell conditional quantile functions define a Hilbert-valued random variable whose variance is the joint disparity. Conditional expectations of this quantile process induce a monotone information game: every reveal order yields an exact martingale decomposition of the same joint disparity, while Shapley values provide an order-free attribution across sens

translated_title: 多敏感属性分布公平性：联合Wasserstein审计与Shapley归因分配
translated_abstract: 针对多个敏感属性的公平性审计通常一次只针对单个属性坐标进行。这可能遗漏纯粹的交叉性差异：一个评分可能与每个敏感坐标各自独立，却依赖于它们的联合特征。我们利用一维Wasserstein几何，研究实值评分的分布性人口统计均等。我们区分了两种互补的构造。条件审计和顺序审计通过其零点集刻画联合均等，但它们的正值通常无法对固定的联合Wasserstein差异进行分解。相比之下，全单元条件分位数函数定义了一个取值于希尔伯特空间的随机变量，其方差即为联合差异。该分位数过程的条件期望诱导出一个单调信息博弈：任意属性揭示顺序都能给出同一联合差异的精确鞅分解，而Shapley值则提供了一种跨敏感属性、与顺序无关的归因分配方法。
tldr: 该论文提出用一维Wasserstein几何对多个敏感属性进行联合公平性审计，将联合差异刻画为全单元条件分位数过程的方差，并借助Shapley值实现与顺序无关的差异归因，从而捕捉单坐标审计会遗漏的交叉性歧视。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes joint Wasserstein-based audits of distributional fairness across multiple sensitive attributes, characterizing joint disparity as the variance of a full-cell conditional quantile process with order-free Shapley attribution, thereby capturing intersectional disparities missed by coordinate-wise audits.
